result.summary: Found 1 issue: the restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' row have inconsistent image heights, causing the text content below to be misaligned across cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the card images have mismatched heights and vertical positions: the 'Green Bowl Poké' card's image is shorter and positioned higher than the 'Smash Bros Burgers' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' cards, and its title/price row sits higher than the neighbors'. This makes the row look visually uneven and misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Give all card thumbnails in the carousel the same fixed aspect ratio/height so titles and delivery fees align consistently across cards.
